orders.title: DECREASING HOUSING COSTS FOR THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
orders.abstract: The American Dream of homeownership is a vital pillar of our great country. It is the policy of my Administration to reduce regulatory barriers to mortgage origination and costs impeding homeownership; embrace innovative risk and value assessment technologies that incorporate Super Intelligence to drive down mortgage…
